native.payload_bytes: Actual serialized sample octets unknown, nonnegative integer; no Ethernet MTU or IPv4 UDP limit as complete DDS sample size. Encoding and fragmentation need explicit profiles.
native.history_kind: Entity-dependent KEEP_LAST proposal for Topic/Writer/Reader; KEEP_ALL is a separate cache policy, not unlimited physical memory.
native.history_depth: KEEP_LAST entity-dependent standard proposal1, replacing10; positive signed32 integer. Ignored by KEEP_ALL; must fit known finite per-instance resource limit.
native.durability: Entity-dependent VOLATILE proposal, with TRANSIENT_LOCAL/TRANSIENT/PERSISTENT requiring matching implementation support and peer contract.
native.liveliness: Entity-dependent AUTOMATIC proposal; manual modes require actual assertion behavior. Lease duration is separately explicit, not NIS clock synchronization.
native.reliability_mode: Standard conditional Writer RELIABLE; Reader/Topic BEST_EFFORT. No global RELIABLE default. History/resource/peer behavior determines delivery; no physical timing guarantee.
native.lifespan_ms: Actual finite sample validity, milliseconds>=0, unknown; zero expires immediately, not infinite. Rejected with explicit INFINITE mode. Writer/Topic only.
native.dds_entity: Required actual DDS entity unknown; selects independent endpoint/container/factory QoS applicability. No automatic Writer/Reader selection.
native.dds_transport_binding: Required actual transport and wire profile reference unknown; DDS middleware does not imply RTPS UDP IPv4 Ethernet. No own rate or capacity proof.
native.dds_implementation_source: Required actual middleware vendor/version/configuration reference unknown. A source string is not verified installed hardware or conformance.
native.dds_type_source: Actual topic type/key/encoding definition reference unknown; Reader/Writer/Topic only. No fabricated CDR or field layout.
native.dds_topic_name: Actual topic name unknown text for Topic/Writer/Reader. No default topic or verified name/type matching.
native.dds_domain_id: Actual domain identifier unknown signed32 IDL long; accepted range only checks declared scalar. Vendor/reserved/transport-port restrictions require actual implementation, no universal0..232 assumption.
native.dds_lifespan_kind: Conditional Writer/Topic INFINITE proposal, finite duration separate. Infinite is explicit symbolic mode, not zero milliseconds.
native.dds_deadline_kind: Conditional endpoint INFINITE deadline proposal. DDS per-instance publication/request period differs from NIS functional deadline.
native.dds_deadline_ms: Actual finite DDS deadline unknown nonnegative finite milliseconds within Duration_t seconds/nanoseconds representation; reader filter must not exceed it.
native.dds_latency_budget_ms: Conditional endpoint zero-millisecond proposal, a middleware hint. It does not prove zero latency or acceptance of functional timing.
native.dds_lease_kind: Conditional endpoint INFINITE liveliness lease proposal; no failure detection timeout inferred.
native.dds_lease_ms: Actual finite liveliness lease unknown nonnegative finite milliseconds; offered/requested lease matching and assertion schedule remain unverified.
native.dds_max_blocking_ms: Conditional reliable Writer100ms standard proposal. Write blocking is not ACK round trip or actuation response. Reader implementation timers are separate.
native.dds_transport_priority: Conditional Topic/Writer zero hint proposal; signed32 integer, no Ethernet PCP0..7 mapping or CAN arbitration ID.
native.dds_destination_order: Conditional endpoint BY_RECEPTION_TIMESTAMP proposal; BY_SOURCE_TIMESTAMP requires actual timestamp semantics. Not Ethernet frame order.
native.dds_max_samples: Conditional endpoint -1 LENGTH_UNLIMITED proposal; otherwise positive signed32 count. Finite count>=known per-instance count; unlimited does not confirm actual memory.
native.dds_max_instances: Conditional endpoint -1 unlimited proposal; otherwise positive signed32 instance count. Not physical device count.
native.dds_max_samples_per_instance: Conditional endpoint -1 unlimited proposal; otherwise positive signed32 count, <=known finite total and >=KEEP_LAST depth.
native.dds_ownership: Conditional endpoint SHARED proposal; EXCLUSIVE is optional feature needing implementation and compatible peers.
native.dds_ownership_strength: Conditional exclusive Writer zero proposal, signed32 strength; actual ownership resolution/liveliness remains unverified.
native.dds_time_based_filter_ms: Conditional Reader zero minimum-separation proposal; finite>=0ms <=known finite reader deadline. Filters application delivery, not wire bandwidth.
native.dds_presentation_scope: Conditional Publisher/Subscriber INSTANCE proposal, TOPIC/GROUP optional capability. Not endpoint History kind.
native.dds_coherent_access: Conditional Publisher/Subscriber False proposal; actual transaction/read logic and matching coherence unverified.
native.dds_ordered_access: Conditional Publisher/Subscriber False proposal; independent of destination ordering and transport sequence.
native.dds_partition_source: Actual reference to partition string sequence unknown. Standard empty sequence matches default partition; sequence/wildcard encoding and matching not implemented by this source field.
native.dds_autoenable_created_entities: Conditional container/factory True proposal; requires actual entity factory behavior. Not automatic engineering-model release approval.
native.dds_autodispose_unregistered: Conditional Writer True proposal; actual unregister/dispose state execution remains unverified.
native.dds_nowriter_purge_kind: Conditional Reader INFINITE no-writer purge proposal; actual lifecycle state is separate.
native.dds_nowriter_purge_ms: Actual finite Reader no-writer purge delay unknown nonnegative milliseconds; rejected with INFINITE mode.
native.dds_disposed_purge_kind: Conditional Reader INFINITE disposed purge proposal; not same as no-writer delay.
native.dds_disposed_purge_ms: Actual finite Reader disposed purge delay unknown nonnegative milliseconds; rejected with INFINITE mode.
native.dds_service_cleanup_kind: Conditional Writer/Topic FINITE duration representation proposal for standard zero cleanup delay. Zero cleanup means never clean cached samples; explicit infinite duration also possible.
native.dds_service_cleanup_ms: Conditional Writer/Topic zero cleanup proposal with standard never-clean semantics. It is not finite zero lifespan or immediate reader purge.
native.dds_service_history_kind: Conditional Writer/Topic KEEP_LAST durability-cache proposal; independent of endpoint History.
native.dds_service_history_depth: Conditional Writer/Topic KEEP_LAST cache-depth1 proposal; positive signed32 count fitting known finite service per-instance resources.
native.dds_service_max_samples: Conditional Writer/Topic -1 unlimited durability-cache samples proposal; finite positive signed32 total>=known per-instance limit.
native.dds_service_max_instances: Conditional Writer/Topic -1 unlimited durability-cache instances proposal; finite positive signed32 count.
native.dds_service_max_samples_per_instance: Conditional Writer/Topic -1 unlimited per-instance durability-cache proposal; independent of endpoint resource limits.
native.dds_user_data_source: Actual reference to user-data octet sequence unknown for Participant/Writer/Reader. Empty sequence is standard initial value; security credentials are not inferred.
native.dds_topic_data_source: Actual reference to Topic data octet sequence unknown. Empty initial sequence does not imply topic sample body or authentication.
native.dds_group_data_source: Actual reference to Publisher/Subscriber group-data octet sequence unknown; empty standard initial value, not device grouping or partition identity.

removed.bitrate: DDS has no own physical link rate; retire inherited Ethernet assumption. Actual selected lower TechnologyProfile owns rate.
removed.mtu_bytes: Link/IP MTU belongs actual lower binding, not DDS serialized sample size.
removed.duplex: Physical duplex belongs actual lower transport; DDS publish/subscribe is not Ethernet full duplex.
removed.vlan_id: No implicit DDS Ethernet VLAN; lower binding must supply it when actually used.
removed.rate_limit_bit_s: Lower link shaper differs from DDS resource/history/time-filter policies.
removed.qos_priority: Ethernet PCP3 is not DDS signed transport-priority hint.
removed.sync_method: DDS liveliness/deadline do not impose PTP/NTP/gPTP or confirm clock synchronization.
removed.reserved_bandwidth_percent: No universal DDS bandwidth reservation percentage.
removed.retransmission_enabled: DDS entity Reliability and selected wire implementation own retransmission behavior.
removed.retransmission_rate: No universal DDS probabilistic retry rate.
removed.retry_limit: DDS does not define generic retry count0/3; actual RTPS/transport state belongs selected profile.
removed.retransmission_delay_ms: No universal DDS retry timer0ms; max blocking is a distinct API policy.
removed.gateway_input_buffer: DDS History/ResourceLimits are not a fixed256-frame gateway buffer.
removed.gateway_output_buffer: No universal DDS256-frame gateway output buffer.

scope: Each original DDS parameter and all22 core QoS policy groups, explicit entity conditional defaults/applicability/infinite duration/unlimited resources/actual type and transport references. Scalar and intra-entity dependency validation with SQL retention.

Executed discovery/RTPS or selected alternative transport, XTypes/CDR encoding/key/sample fragmentation/security and peer mappings remain unverified
Capacity model remains MODEL_MISSING; resource/scalar validity is not transport scheduling, delivery timing, installed memory or functional acceptance
